svg.title: Driver and field (tp::driver, tp::field): the competitors

g.text: Driver and field (tp::driver, tp::field): the competitors
+best_gear(const Puller&, sled, track, lowest, highest, max_m, max_s) : optional<int>
+guess_gear(const Puller&, best, lowest, highest, SplitMix64&) : int
+play_event(rules, const Venue&, const Field&, variation, pull_to_pull,
each puller: the reference with torque, mass, tire grip, gear and clutch drawn;
torque tuned down to the class's PTO limit (bisection), mass capped at its limit;
pitch inertia follows the mass; the same seed gives the same field everywhere;
at each event every driver guesses a gear (the best as often as they read the track),
and every pull differs a little in grip and clutch timing
